name: WPA PROTOCOLometry COMMAND CENTER
baseline_note: Initial safe baseline committed before the first branch CI rights/source verification run. Machine-generated values replace this baseline when build-command-center.mjs is executed in a governed cycle.

sources_and_academies.rule: Lawful independent sources continue; source failures never relax access or reuse rules.

rights_and_provenance.rule: Fail-closed rights/source gate is implemented in code and awaits first branch CI execution.

wpa_native_transformation.rule: Only originality-pass, rights-eligible evidence may enter downstream WPA-native context.

membership.rule: Active member identity requires a protected authoritative registry; public-repo PII is prohibited.

partnerships.rule: Partner discovery and due diligence may be prepared; activation requires Human Gate and applicable agreement.

monetization.rule: No payment, invoice or benefit-redemption activation is claimed without an authorised payment/contractual backend.
